articles.title: Cisco FMC Flaws Exploited to Steal Credentials and Deploy Qilin Ransomware
articles.executive_summary: Three threat clusters are exploiting CVE-2026-20079 to steal credentials and deploy Qilin ransomware, posing a significant operational risk to enterprises. The attacks bypass authentication in the Cisco FMC web interface, allowing remote attackers to access sensitive information.
articles.technical_breakdown: The attacks exploit CVE-2026-20079, an authentication bypass vulnerability in the FMC web interface, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass security controls and access sensitive information. This vulnerability has a CVSS score of 10.0, indicating a critical severity.
actionable_mitigations: Apply the latest patches for CVE-2026-20079 to the FMC software
Implement network containment and firewall rules to block unauthorized access to the FMC web interface
Monitor logs for suspicious activity and implement detection indicators for Qilin ransomware
articles.telegram_snippet: Cisco FMC vulnerabilities exploited to steal credentials and deploy Qilin ransomware, posing a critical risk to enterprises. Apply latest patches and monitor logs for suspicious activity.

articles.executive_summary: China-Linked UNC3569 Exploited Sogou Input Method Flaw to Deploy GRAYRABBIT Backdoor. articles.title: PaperCut Replaces Emergency Patches With Fixes for Two Actively Exploited Flaws
articles.executive_summary: PaperCut has released emergency patches to address two actively exploited security flaws. The patches have been replaced with regular maintenance releases for versions 26.0.5, 25.0.13, and 24.1.10.
articles.technical_breakdown: The security flaws were under active exploitation, prompting PaperCut to release emergency patches. The patches have now been replaced with regular maintenance releases that address the vulnerabilities.
actionable_mitigations: Update to PaperCut NG/MF versions 26.0.5, 25.0.13, or 24.1.10
articles.telegram_snippet: PaperCut has released regular maintenance releases to address two actively exploited security flaws, replacing previous emergency patches.

articles.title: Indonesia Hit by Android Banking App-Cloning Campaign
articles.threat_category: Ransomware | Data Breach | 0-Day & Exploit | Nation-State/APT | Cloud & Supply Chain | Vulnerability / Advisory
articles.executive_summary: The GoldFactory threat group is exploiting the Android Work Profile feature to deliver the Gigabud Trojan, targeting Indonesian users. This campaign poses a significant risk to financial institutions and individuals using Android banking apps.
articles.technical_breakdown: The attackers leverage the Android Work Profile feature to sideload the Gigabud Trojan, which allows them to bypass security restrictions and gain unauthorized access to sensitive data. The Mantax Otax malware spreads separately, further compromising user devices.
actionable_mitigations: Ensure Android devices are running the latest security patches and updates
Disable the Android Work Profile feature if not required
Implement robust mobile security solutions, including antivirus software and firewalls
articles.telegram_snippet: GoldFactory threat group targets Indonesian Android users with Gigabud Trojan, exploiting Work Profile feature. Users advised to update devices and enable robust mobile security measures.

articles.title: New Android malware encrypts files, steals data, and harasses victims
articles.executive_summary: A new Android malware strain, Mantax Otax, combines ransomware and spyware capabilities to encrypt files, steal sensitive data, and harass victims. This malware poses a significant threat to Android users, emphasizing the need for enhanced security measures.
articles.technical_breakdown: Mantax Otax malware exploits Android vulnerabilities to gain unauthorized access, encrypt files, and steal sensitive data. The malware's ability to spam and harass victims adds to its complexity and operational risk.
actionable_mitigations: Ensure Android devices are running the latest security patches
Use reputable antivirus software and enable real-time scanning
Be cautious when installing apps from unknown sources
articles.telegram_snippet: New Android malware, Mantax Otax, combines ransomware and spyware capabilities, encrypting files, stealing data, and harassing victims. Android users are advised to update their devices and use reputable antivirus software to mitigate this threat.
